tables.title: Table (Page 3)

rows.Definition:
A licensed nurse practitioner (NP) or physician assistant (PA)
billing under their own NPI for services provided to a Devoted
Health member.

A NUCC taxonomy code that, despite its formal classification
level, fails to identify a definitive, non-primary clinical specialty
or specific area of practice for the purpose of benefit
determination. 
This includes Level II generic classifications (e.g.,
363L00000X-Nurse Practitioner, or 363A00000X-Physician
Assistant, as well as broad Level III specifications (e.g.,
363LF0000X- Family Nurse Practitioner) where the scope of
practice can span both primary and sub-specialty clinics.

A Level III NUCC taxonomy code that identifies a specific clinical
specialty or focus area within the NP or PA classification (e.g.,
363LP0808X - Psychiatric-Mental Health NP).

The plan benefit tier - Primary Care or Specialty - that governs
the member cost-sharing applied to a given claim, as defined in
the applicable Evidence of Coverage (EOC).

Any claim-level or provider-level data element that affirmatively
indicates the rendering provider was functioning in a primary
care capacity at the time of service. See Section 5 for qualifying
signals.

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: This policy establishes Devoted Health's process for handling claims submitted by out of

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: network mid-level practitioners (nurse practitioners and physician assistants) who submit

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: claims with ambiguous, non-specialty-specific taxonomy codes.

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: This policy is intended to:

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: ● Ensure accurate member cost-sharing determinations and protect members from

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: inappropriate out-of-network cost-sharing inflation.

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: ● Enforce accurate, granular coding standards for out-of-network providers rendering

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: services to Devoted Health members.

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: ● Establish a clear path for providers to re-submit claims with the appropriate clinical

extracted_content.title: PURPOSE
extracted_content.content: specialty taxonomy.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: APPLICABILITY

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: This policy applies to:

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: ● All out-of-network (non-contracted) claims submitted to Devoted Health under any

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: Medicare Advantage plan.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: ● Claims where the rendering provider holds a Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: Assistant (PA) license type and has submitted an ambiguous, classification-level

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: taxonomy code.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: ● Claims where a definitive benefit category (PCP vs. Specialty) cannot be determined

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: due to missing or ambiguous provider specialty data.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: This policy does not apply to:

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: ● In-network (contracted) providers, whose benefit categories are governed by provider

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: contract terms and standard network mapping.

extracted_content.title: APPLICABILITY
extracted_content.content: ● Claims billed "incident-to" a supervising physician under the physician's NPI.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: POLICY

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: When standard claim data is insufficient to definitively determine whether a Primary Care

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: (PCP) or Specialty cost share should apply, Devoted Health will deny the claim as provider

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: liable to protect the member. Devoted Health is required to accurately apply member benefits

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: based on the nature of the service provided. Ambiguous taxonomy codes from out-of-network

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: mid-level providers withhold the clinical context necessary to differentiate between primary

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: care and specialty visits.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Conditions for Denial

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: The claim denies when all of the following are true:

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: The rendering provider is identified as an NP (taxonomy group 363L) or PA (taxonomy

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: group 363A).

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: The taxonomy code submitted on the claim is an ambiguous NP or PA taxonomy code

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: or no rendering provider taxonomy submitted on the claim.

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: The billing/supervising provider taxonomy does not affirmatively indicate a Primary

extracted_content.title: POLICY
extracted_content.content: Care setting.
